payload.text: **0035 ruled on vc's four recommendations** (hv, 2026-09-16, to vc in session). (1) Built-in groups are a DEFAULT on a verb axis, overridable, and the axis is documented beside help.groups. (2) `precommit` runs a project's gate and never wires hooks; the per-clone loss of .git/hooks wiring is filed as its own issue. (3) A dev harness stays in cmd/ with no builtin or convention until a second estate grows one. (4) The two cleans' boundary is stated: the built-in owns the language artefact trees it names, and a project clean scopes to what that project's own build produced.
